title: Empty SelectableFields in build info means 'none mapped', not 'unknown'
answers: why does an existing index always fall back to the store scan for field filters
selectable field filters unexpectedly slow after upgrading
build info SelectableFields is empty but the index should have the field
index built by an older version refuses all selectable field filters
body: bleveIndex.mappedSelectableFields is populated from the index's build info (getBuildInfo) and an empty list is deliberately interpreted as 'this index maps zero selectable fields' rather than 'unknown', so any selectable-field filter gets refused via rejectUnmappedSelectableFields. Indexes built between grafana PRs #116939 and #117416 mapped selectable fields into bleve without recording them in build info; such indexes get incorrectly refused and degrade to the slower store scan instead of returning a wrong (empty) answer. This is the intended trade-off (refuse-and-fallback is safe, silently-wrong is not) — don't 'fix' it by treating an empty list as unknown.
applies: pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go index build-info handling, when reasoning about old/mixed-version indexes
